Class UpdateMessage

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am31.am31.network.messages.Message
it.polimi.ingsw.am31.am31.network.messages.updateMessages.UpdateMessage
Direct Known Subclasses:
CardLineUpdate, EndGameUpdate, GameCrashUpdate, GameEventResolveUpdate, GameRoundStatusUpdate, GameStartUpdate, OfferTrackUpdate, PlayerBonusDrawUpdate, PlayerBuildingsUpdate, PlayerScoresUpdate, PlayersListUpdate, PlayerTribeUpdate, ShowLobbyUpdate, SuccessRegistrationUpdate, TurnOrderUpdate
public abstract class UpdateMessage extends Message
Base class for all server-to-client state update messages. Each update carries the full state of what it describes rather than just the delta (e.g. the entire player tribe, not just the card that was drawn). Uses IUpdateVisitor to dispatch each subtype to the correct handler
